title: THE MATCH-CUT OPEN
cites: laws/BOHEMIA_ADDENDUM_ACT1_OPENING_VISION_7_19_26.md - THE MATCH-CUT OPEN (7/19, Paolo, locked shape) and OPENING SEQUENCE CRYSTALLIZED beat 1 (NIGHT RAID)
note: AUTHORED FROM THE LOCKED SHAPE. Every beat traces to a line of his 7/19 addendum, quoted in `why`. ALWAYS MAKE AN ATTEMPT (Paolo 8/11, LOCKED): every line below is a REAL attempt at the words, written as if it ships, and tagged draft:true so he can find and edit every one. The previous version shipped these beats SILENT under the old empty-contents reading, and his own diagnosis was that the blank page is what stopped the quests. STRUCTURE IS STILL HIS: who dies, who lives, the casualties, the dials -- none of that is decided here.

beats.why: 'The game opens on a PRE-APOCALYPSE family dinner... the family whole, the world intact, a warm happy moment at the table.'
the framing must be IDENTICAL either side of the cut or the match-cut does not read as the same table.
'You are a CHILD, the family whole.'
'the family whole' at the pre-collapse table. He is the one who wakes you ten years later, so the player must have seen him whole first.
'the family whole' at the pre-collapse table. The cold open ends saving her, so she is established here before she is at risk.
the older sibling is the SAME GENDER as the player (7/19 RESOLVED); the surface picks which body from creation.

the one taken on night one sits at this table first, so the empty chair later has a memory attached. 'MOTIF SEED: the sibling's EMPTY CHAIR persists at family meals' is [PENDING] and is NOT built here.

beats.speaker: mother
beats.text: Sit down, both of you. It's getting cold.
beats.why: 'a warm happy moment at the table' (7/19). ATTEMPT (8/11 rule): the most ordinary sentence in the world, on purpose -- the cut has to take something SMALL and real, not a speech. 'Both of you' quietly establishes two siblings before one of them is gone. EDIT FREELY.

beats.speaker: sibling_lost
beats.text: I'm not eating the green ones.
beats.why: ATTEMPT (8/11 rule): the sibling who is taken on night one gets one line, and it is a child being a child about vegetables. Nothing portentous. The whole weight of this scene depends on her being unremarkable here. WHICH sibling is lost is HIS ruling (7/19 leaning) -- this speaks whoever the surface casts. EDIT FREELY.
the warmth has to land before it is taken, or the cut costs nothing.

'Then a blink / match-cut: the SAME table, ~10 years later, now in a dingy post-apocalypse house, you are 20-something. The single cut shows the entire apocalypse without a word.' THIS BEAT IS THE WHOLE OPENING.
same place, ten years on. What the world was, what it became.
'you are 20-something' - same seat, same framing, different person.
'the 10-YEAR ANNIVERSARY OF THE FOURTH OF JULY... the one night you see recreational FIREWORKS'. It also sets up the raid: 'you can't always tell a firework from a muzzle flash'.

beats.speaker: sibling_older
beats.text: Same chair. Ten years and you still take the same chair.
beats.why: ATTEMPT (8/11 rule): the first line after the cut has to make the audience LOOK at the table again and understand what happened without narration. It also names the empty seat without naming it. Sits on the [PENDING] EMPTY CHAIR motif seed WITHOUT building it. EDIT FREELY.

beats.speaker: father
beats.text: Up. Now. Don't turn the light on.
beats.why: 'Your FATHER wakes you: bandits/raiders are attacking the home.' ATTEMPT (8/11 rule): low and flat, not shouted -- a man who has thought about this night before it came. The third sentence does the work: it tells you they are close enough to see a window, without a word of exposition. EDIT FREELY.

'The tutorial IS the family-defense fight. You learn the (fun) combat by fending them off room to room.' NAMED TO COMBAT'S OWN CONTRACT (8/11, tools/bohemia_alpha_cold_open_patch.py): they expose startColdOpen(onEnd) with encounterId 'cold_open'. My first version said 'family_defense' and the two halves WOULD NOT HAVE MET -- two lanes building complementary pieces that never connect is this repo's most expensive recurring bug, so the gate now checks the name against theirs instead of trusting it.

'It ends when you save your MOTHER from a raider. The assault is INFERRED, never shown or dwelt on.' The saving beat and the sibling's death are COMBAT's and his to author; the scene returns control here rather than dramatising something he has not ruled.
